name: message
comment: The Prism's message formatter (app/src/PrismMessage.lex.tex), which words every reply, held to the Unicode MessageFormat 2.0 test suite of release LDML 48.2. 'text' pins the specification (UTS #35 Part 9) and 'suite' the test files, each by SHA-256 at the release's commit. A request is 'check', a line break, a file's defaultTestProperties object, then test objects of that file, every byte as Unicode publishes it; the guest runs each test by the suite's own rules (the text when 'exp' is given, the error types in order when 'expErrors' lists them, no error otherwise) and answers 'pass', or 'fail', the index of the first failing test and what came out. 'examples' here are the tests of syntax.json and are the acceptance vectors of the guest 'message'; rules/spec.json carries the other files as the vectors of 'message-rules', built from the same module, because one build holds about 30 KB of vectors. 'held' lists, per file, the tests in those vectors. 'debt' lists every test not yet passed, by cause: number-and-date-functions (:number, :integer, :offset, :percent, :currency, :date, :time, :datetime are not yet implemented and answer unknown-function), normalization (names and keys are not yet compared in Unicode Normalization Form C), locale-numbers (a number given without a function is not yet formatted for the locale). Formatting to parts (expParts) is not compared. Two more requests serve the page: 'format' and 'parts', each followed by one object with locale, bidiIsolation, src and params; 'format' answers the error types on one line and then the text, 'parts' adds a line per expression placeholder (start and end in code points of the text, then its source) before an empty line and the text.
